text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] 03:11 UTC - warmup error surge: model-load failures in pool-eu-west1-gpu-a (error rate 18%)

Anna: seeing warmup failures and repeated CUDA illegal address + deserialize EOFs, paging SRE.

Matt: oncall grabbing it. any recent model pushes to that pool?

Anna: pushed gptx-7b-quant-opt-v2 at 02:50 UTC, small shard size change.

Rachel: logs show patterns: "EOF while reading" on deserializers, then alloc failures, then kernel illegal-address. sample:
```
2026-02-18T03:05:12Z warmup[pid=5120]: shard=1 load: deserialize error: unexpected EOF
2026-02-18T03:05:13Z warmup[pid=5120]: cuda alloc failed: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
2026-02-18T03:05:15Z runtime: kernel_compile timeout 45s for fused_attention
2026-02-18T03:05:16Z kernel: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS at 0x7fbac0
```

Matt: sounds like corrupt artifact + memory pressure during JIT compile. we should stop rollouts to that pool and lower warmup parallelism.

sre-lead: proposed immediate actions: 1) suspend warmup triggers to pool-eu-west1-gpu-a 2) scale warmup down to 1 concurrent per node 3) drain warmup jobs 4) route customer traffic to pool-eu-west1-gpu-b (stable).

Matt: suspending warmup launcher now.

Matt: kubectl -n inference patch cronjob warmup-launcher --patch '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'

Anna: canceling running warmups on hosts eu1-node-5, eu1-node-9.

incident-bot: rollout freeze applied by oncall at 03:12 UTC for pool-eu-west1-gpu-a

customer-success: flagging — two enterprise customers have higher p50 latencies in the region, preparing comms.

Rachel: restarting runtime pods on affected nodes to clear CUDA state.

Matt: restart command:
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime -n eu-west-1 --selector=pool=gpu-a
```

Rachel: one pod recovered, another entered CrashLoopBackOff with OOM at init.

infra-oncall: joining — node eu1-node-9 shows mismatched NVIDIA driver after a rolling kernel update. initiating driver rollback and node reprovision.

Anna: routing change to pool-eu-west1-gpu-b in progress, using weighted routing: 85% to gpu-b, 15% to older quantized fallback in gpu-a.

Matt: telemetry post-reroute: 5xx rate down from 18% to 1.1% in 3m. good.

customer-success: confirmed transient 500 spikes, retries cleared most errors. drafting a short incident update.

sre-lead: plan for follow-up: collect corrupted shard artifacts, add checksum validation before warmup, enforce driver-version gate on rollouts, add config for warmup memory cap and JIT compile timeouts.

Matt: handoff in 25m. @Rachel you'll own post-incident analysis and SLO impact calc. I'll file the incident ticket and summary.

Rachel: acknowledged. creating INC-20260218-02 with logs, node diagnostics, and the bad artifact attached.

incident-bot: status -> MITIGATED at 03:26 UTC. assigned to Rachel for postmortem.

sre-lead: run a synthetic test: simulate concurrent warmups + corrupt artifact to ensure the new preflight catches it.

Anna: will add to runtime test suite and add a precompile fallback flag to shipping config. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
